data.description: storage.py:260-273. History written before entity write. Failed write leaves history inconsistent. Fix: Save history AFTER successful write.

properties.retrospective: Already fixed in prior ACID commit. storage.py now uses crash-safe pending history pattern: history is written to pending file first, only finalized AFTER successful entity write. Verified during WAL entity rollback implementation review.
